title: Very disappointing
text: Very disappointing. The 1st set I bought was the rich cream color for almost $40. These were lush and soft in the package and even loftier and soft after washing. I went back to but 2 more sets but not available so I ordered sandstone and a blue set for almost $30 a set.  These arrived thin and almost crispy to the touch.  I washed them hoping they would fluff up a bit but they did not. The bath towels are a nice big size but that is my only good comment on these. Holding the washcloth up to the light you can sit light coming through the weave. Don't waste your money on these.
